verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no user-definable rule or workflow builder where a user sets a trigger condition and an automatic action. What it does show is adjacent: built-in email alerts when tests fail or change status, customizable reminders for recurring tasks such as quarterly reviews (scheduled, not event-driven), and follow-up tasks that sync to ticketing tools inside the access-review workflow. These are fixed vendor-defined behaviors and schedules, not user-authored event rules.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
